entity.name: Secrets Vault
entity.description:
Secrets Vault is a cybersecurity company focused on post-quantum authentication and sensitive data protection.

Today, digital security relies on passwords, hardware tokens and stored secrets. These models are complex, costly to operate and increasingly vulnerable to phishing, credential theft, AI-driven attacks and future quantum threats.

Secrets Vault takes a different approach.

We use ordinary images as the basis for security. Users select images that act as access elements, from which cryptographic keys are generated locally on the user device. Images are never modified and never store secrets. Cryptographic keys are created on demand and are never stored or transmitted.

This model reduces attack surface, avoids centralized secrets, and supports compliance with frameworks such as NIS2, DORA, GDPR and ISO 27001 without adding operational complexity.

🔐Post-quantum passwordless authentication
Secrets Vault enables strong authentication by using images as cryptographic access factors, instead of passwords. These images can be used for passwordless login, as a 2FA, or combined with elements such as biometrics or contextual signals.

This approach reduces the cost of traditional authentication systems, it integrates easily with existing infrastructures, requires no software installation on user devices, and delivers a simple, secure user experience even in hybrid or distributed environments.

🗂️ Sensitive data protection & secure sharing
The same cryptographic foundation is applied to protect and securely share sensitive digital information, including legal, financial, personal and intellectual property data.

Keys are generated locally and never stored. This enables strong confidentiality, clear auditability and secure sharing without exposing sensitive information.

Built by a team with decades of experience in cryptography, cybersecurity and digital identity, Secrets Vault delivers security designed to last.

Let's talk!

📩 hello@secretsvault.net

Secure Vault (also known as GenZ Vault) is Coralgenz’s most advanced and trusted secure web app, built to protect your important files with the highest level of security available today. Protected by AES-256 Encryption

Your files are protected using AES-256 encryption, one of the strongest encryption standards in the world. This is the same level of security used by banks, governments, and global enterprises.

What this means for you:

Your files are locked before they are stored
No one can read your data without permission
Even system access cannot view your content
Your privacy stays fully protected at all times

Full Control Over Who Can Access Your Files

Secure Vault gives you complete control over your content. You decide:

Who can access your file
When they can access it
How many times it can be opened
How long it should exist

This web app is designed for individuals, professionals, creators, startups, and companies who need strong privacy without technical complexity. 

Secure Vault offers multiple access options so you can choose the right level of protection for each file.



One-Time Unlock (Persistent Access)

Enter the password once and access the file anytime without asking again. Best for trusted users and regular access.



Always Ask Password

A password is required every time the file is opened. Perfect for highly confidential documents.



View Once Mode

The file can be opened only one time. After viewing, it deletes itself automatically and cannot be accessed again.
